Training Gym R53 completed! ALL 4 CLEAN ON FIRST TRY!

1. tarjan-scc-001 (T7) - Tarjan's SCC with disc/low arrays, stack, on_stack. O(V+E).
2. fenwick-001 (T6) - Fenwick Tree (BIT) with LSB trick. Prefix sum + range query + point update. O(n) build from array.
3. segment-tree-001 (T7) - Segment Tree with array representation. Range sum query + point update.
4. rabin-karp-001 (T6) - Rolling hash string matching, base=256, mod=10^9+7. Verified with overlapping patterns.

MILESTONE: 200 exercises passed!
DB: 265 exercises, 451 attempts, avg 9.88, 94.2% perfect.
17+ consecutive rounds all 10/10.

Key algorithms learned this round:
- Tarjan's SCC: disc/low tracking, stack for SCC candidate set, root when low==disc
- Fenwick Tree: 1-indexed, LSB trick i&-i for navigation. O(n) build: tree[i+1]=arr[i], propagate to parent
- Segment Tree: power-of-2 size, array at [size+i], bottom-up build. Query: l odd→add, r even→add
- Rabin-Karp: rolling hash (hash - old*base^(m-1))*base + new, always verify actual match
decisions: Tarjan: low[v]=min(low[v], index[w]) not low[w] for back edges (on_stack check)
Fenwick: 1-indexed internally, convert with i+1 for 0-indexed API
Segment tree: power-of-2 size, query uses l%2==1 (right child) and r%2==0 (left child)
Rabin-Karp: precompute h=base^(m-1) for O(1) removal, always verify hash matches
